---
title: "Lecture 64 — Self-check answers"
sidebar: mfml
---

1. The positive key $k^+$ among negatives (for a query $q$).
2. Two random augmentations of the same image; encode both and treat them as a match.
3. Sharpens or softens the softmax over similarities (controls how peaked the match is).
4. Representation / embedding space (not raw pixels).
5. No — pretraining is self-supervised; labels are optional for downstream eval.
